Indian Cricketers Fail in Ranji Trophy Match

Several Indian opening batsmen, including Yashasvi Jaiswal and KL Rahul, had a poor performance in a Ranji Trophy match. Jaiswal was out without scoring any runs, while Rahul was dismissed for 4 runs. This marks a disappointing outing for the national team stars in domestic cricket.
